summary: This bill allows the recall and reappointment of separated Foreign Service members, in addition to retired members, for five years after their departure, requires their reappointment within 180 days, and mandates annual reports to Congress on these recalls and reappointments.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Foreign Service Act to facilitate the recall and reappointment of former career members. While this could involve some administrative costs and salaries for reappointed individuals, the bill itself does not directly appropriate funds or significantly alter overall government spending levels. The financial implications are incidental to its primary purpose of workforce management.
